test_stimuli.name: ch0_mid_scale
test_stimuli.derivation: Response bytes: [0x00, 0x7F, 0xFF]. high_byte=0x7F, low_byte=0xFF. raw = ((0x7F & 0x03) << 8) | 0xFF = (0x03 << 8) | 0xFF = 0x3FF = 1023. But 0x7F & 0x03 = 0x03, so raw = 0x03FF = 1023. Wait, 0x7F & 0x03 = 0x03, so raw = (0x03 << 8) | 0xFF = 0x3FF = 1023. That's full scale. raw = ((0x20 & 0x03) << 8) | 0x00 = (0x00 << 8) | 0x00 = 0. Not mid. Choose [0x00, 0x7F, 0x00] -> high_byte=0x7F, low_byte=0x00. raw = ((0x7F & 0x03) << 8) | 0x00 = (0x03 << 8) | 0x00 = 0x300 = 768. That's 75% of 1023. For mid-scale 512, need raw=512. 512 = 0x200. So high_byte bits [1:0] = 0x02, low_byte = 0x00. So high_byte = 0x80? Actually high_byte = 0x80 gives 0x80 & 0x03 = 0x00, not 0x02. Need high_byte such that (high_byte & 0x03) = 0x02 and low_byte = 0x00. So high_byte = 0x82? 0x82 & 0x03 = 0x02. So response bytes: [0x00, 0x82, 0x00]. Then raw = ((0x82 & 0x03) << 8) | 0x00 = (0x02 << 8) | 0x00 = 0x200 = 512. So expected_channels ch0 = 512.
